services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Boston Whaler has the reputation of building safe, durable, stable and smooth riding boats. Our 30 Foot Boston Whaler 305 Conquest powered with twin 250HP Mercury Verados is large enough to comfortably take up to six passengers. This offshore boat is designed to provided comfort and stability while fishing and cruising. The covered space provides enclosed protection from the rain and shade from the sun. The 54 square foot back deck has lots of room to play fish, take pictures and sit back and enjoy the sunshine. On board amenities include enclosed stand up head with flushing toilet, heater, and fridge. We are equipped with all required navigation equipment including sonar, radar, GPS,

services.name: Scenic Boat Tours
services.desc: We offer a leisurely cruise to take in the wildlife and scenery of Howe Sound and Bowen Island. Howe Sound tour you’ll travel north up Howe Sound about 8 Kilometres to Pam Rocks to view a seal colony of 200 harbour seals. On the way up and back you take in the natural beauty of the Coastal mountain range bordering both sides Howe Sound and the islands that are nestled within. There is an abundance of sea birds to view as well as eagles and turkey vultures. Occasionally seeing orcas and humpback whales.
